versions.changelog:
Airbnb & Short-Term Rental Listing Optimizer v1.0.0

- Launches a four-prompt system to automate and optimize short-term rental listings for platforms like Airbnb and VRBO.
- Outputs include headline/SEO description, photo captions, platform-formatted house rules and FAQ, and a 6-message automated guest communication sequence.
- Designed for hosts, property managers, real estate investors, co-hosts, and hotel owners expanding into OTA platforms.
- Provides clear input requirements for each prompt to generate tailored, publication-ready copy.
- Introduces a free tier (headline + description) and paid upgrade for full functionality.
